results.description: I have a weakness for strong drink.
I'm too greedy for my own good; I can't resist taking risks for money.
I have trouble trusting anyone, even close friends.
I'm quick to anger and slow to forgive.
I'll do almost anything to avoid conflict, even if it means lying.
I secretly believe I'm better than everyone else.
I would betray a friend before I'd admit I was wrong.
I can't resist mocking those weaker than myself.
I've never met a lie I couldn't tell with a straight face.
I hold a grudge long after everyone else has forgotten the offense.
I would rather watch someone struggle than offer help unasked.
I take pleasure in the misfortune of people I don't like.
I can't stand to see someone else get credit for my work.
I'll cut down anyone who stands between me and what I want.
I trust no one, not even the people who've earned it.
I have a cruel sense of humor that rarely lands well.
I'm quick to threaten violence, even when words would do.
I can't resist a bet, even one I know I'll lose.
I've abandoned people before when the danger got too real.
I enjoy having power over others more than I should admit.
I lie about my past so often I've started to believe it myself.
I'll sell out an ally the moment it benefits me.
I have no patience for those I consider beneath me.
I collect grudges the way some people collect coins.
I'm loyal only for as long as it's convenient.
I've never apologized for anything, even when I know I should.
I take what I want and worry about the consequences later.
I'm easily bored, and boredom makes me reckless.
I flatter people I intend to ruin.
I can't resist rubbing my successes in a rival's face.
I've hurt people who never did anything to deserve it.
I assume the worst of everyone, and I'm rarely disappointed.
I'll lie to a friend's face without a flicker of guilt.
I enjoy watching an argument more than ending one.
I've never forgiven a slight, no matter how small.
I have a taste for cruelty I try, and often fail, to hide.
I use people until they're no longer useful to me.
I'm convinced that everyone is secretly plotting against me.
I'll break a promise the moment it stops serving me.
I take petty jealousy out on people who don't deserve it.
I have no loyalty to anyone who can't help me.
I'll say anything to get out of trouble, true or not.
I find other people's pain easier to laugh at than to pity.
I've stolen from friends when I thought I could get away with it.
I can't stand losing, even at something meaningless.
I speak before I think, and it has cost me dearly.
I've never once admitted a mistake was mine to own.
I hold everyone to a standard I don't hold myself to.
I'll abandon a cause the moment it becomes inconvenient.
I enjoy scaring people more than I probably should.
I've betrayed people who trusted me, more than once.
I can't resist twisting the truth to make myself look better.
I have a temper that's gotten me exiled from more than one place.
I'll take credit for things I had no hand in.
I've let innocent people take the blame for my mistakes.
I'm suspicious of kindness and assume it's a trick.
I can't stand being told what to do, even when I'm wrong.
I hoard secrets like weapons, waiting for the right moment to use them.
I've left people behind when saving them was inconvenient.
I enjoy the fear I inspire in others more than I should.
I'll gladly let someone else take a risk I'm not willing to take myself.
I can't resist provoking people who are clearly trying to avoid a fight.
I've never once kept a promise that stopped being useful to me.
I judge everyone by how useful they are to me.
I take insults personally and remember them for years.
I'm quicker to punish than to forgive.
I've ruined relationships out of simple spite.
I can't resist manipulating people, even those I claim to care about.
I've hurt someone badly once, and part of me enjoyed it.
I lie reflexively, even when the truth would serve me better.
I can't resist showing off, even when it puts others at risk.
I'll abandon my principles the moment they become expensive.
I take petty pleasure in other people's failures.
I've betrayed a cause I once believed in, and I'd do it again.
I assume violence solves most problems, and I'm rarely talked out of it.
I can't stand sharing credit, even when I didn't do the work alone.
I've let my ambition cost other people everything.
I find it satisfying to watch people squirm.
I can't resist needling people about their weaknesses.
I've made promises I never intended to keep.
I have very little patience for anyone slower than me.
I take advantage of trust the moment it's offered.
I can't resist the urge to win, even at someone else's expense.
I hold others responsible for my own failures.
I've turned on allies the moment the odds shifted.
I enjoy other people's fear far more than I let on.
I can't resist a grudge, even a decades-old one.
I've let cruelty pass for humor more times than I can count.
I trust my blade more than I trust my word.
I've abandoned oaths the moment they stopped benefiting me.
I can't resist testing how far someone's loyalty will bend before it breaks.
I find satisfaction in being feared rather than liked.
I've sacrificed people I called friends when it suited me.
I hold contempt for anyone who shows mercy.
I can't resist punishing weakness wherever I see it.
I've burned bridges out of pure spite, knowing I'd regret it.
I take more pleasure in winning than the victory is worth.
I've let my temper decide things my judgment should have.
I can't resist the thrill of getting away with something terrible.
I can't resist twisting a situation to make someone else look guilty.
